L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès
Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean.

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 850 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA.

Ton équipe :
Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Tes futures missions :
En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement.

Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo :


  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements




Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :

  • BPI France : En mars 2020, en pleine crise Covid, Theodo conçoit et déploie en 5 jours la plateforme des Prêts Garantis par l’État (PGE). Sécurisée, scalable dès le lancement et accessible à toutes les banques françaises sans formation, elle a permis de piloter en temps réel le dispositif et de soutenir le déploiement de 115 milliards d’euros de prêts dans l’économie française
  • Nickel : Pour accélérer la diversification de son offre, l’entreprise lance un mini-crédit 100 % digital intégré à son application, en partenariat avec Floa. En seulement 5 mois (dont 11 semaines pour la V1), une équipe de 5 experts Fintech Theodo conçoit et déploie l’offre, malgré une intégration API complexe et de fortes dépendances internes. Résultat : un parcours fluide mêlant natif et webview, permettant à Nickel d’augmenter la rétention et l’ARPU tout en restant fidèle à sa promesse d’inclusion financière




Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python…

Tes perspectives d'évolution :

  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique

  • Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur

About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. We are known for our extensive integration of technology into field processes; our quantitative approach to performance measurement; and our commitment to rigorous, independent, experimental evaluation of our impact, with multiple Randomized Control Trials completed and others in progress.

How we work

Our team spans 20+ countries and 69 languages. Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We expect high ownership and give people real responsibility early. Our values are central to how we hire, work, and grow, and they are deliberately opinionated:

  1. Recipients first. Recipients’ preferences come before those of donors or ourselves.
  2. Team next. We optimize for organizational success, not individual success.
  3. Be proactively candid. We say what we believe and share information openly.
  4. Create positive energy. We aim to be a source of energy for colleagues, not a drain.
  5. Think rigorously; act quickly. We reason from first principles, then act rather than debate.
  6. Know yourself and grow. We own our imperfections and seek feedback to grow.
  7. Accept reality. Propose solutions. We focus on what can change and bring solutions, not just problems.
  8. Be productively ambitious. We take risks for step-change impact, not incremental progress.

If they describe how you like to work and they energize you, this could be a great fit.

Want to learn more? Read and listen:

We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026, and our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We're now preparing to deliver billions of dollars a year to people in extreme poverty, if funding allows. Read our CEO's essay on what that will take.

About this role:

Are you an experienced engineer at the stage of your career where, above all, you want to do good?

This role is about using engineering to support fundraising: delighting our donors; helping our fundraisers; getting donations recorded and safely started on their journey to our recipients; telling donors and the public about what happens to their gifts. A bit of website development. A lot of plumbing.

The good news about this position:

  • You will make a difference to people in extreme poverty
  • You will work independently, with few constraints
  • You will work directly with lovely people from across our fundraising teams

The trade-offs:

  1. There is only one other fundraising engineer and mostly you will be working on your own
  2. Our technology is a mixture of boring (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML and CSS) and legacy (Salesforce, Wordpress, wrangling CSV files sent by our partners)
  3. We're growing, but this is a role for someone who values depth and impact over a fast title ladder.

The maybe good maybe bad news about the role depending on who you are:

  • We are all in on AI where it allows us to get more $ to people in extreme poverty

If you want a role where you will be part of a bigger engineering team, working in Python or working on more complex tasks, then please take a look at our other engineering roles.

This role is right for you if:

  • You care about our mission
  • You agree with our values
  • You have the right to work in one of the countries we're able to hire from (you can check the current list here).
  • You're happy working remotely, and taking meetings across East Africa Time and US Eastern Time.
  • You are happy to travel to meet your colleagues in the US, Europe and Africa a few weeks a year
  • You are fluent in English
  • You have 4+ years of engineering experience
  • You're happy working autonomously: defining what needs doing, doing it, getting it tested and launched, fixing the bugs, and hustling to make progress every day.
  • You're comfortable being on-call on peak donation days (Giving Tuesday and the last weeks of the year), including owning an incident: working out what matters, communicating with fundraisers, and debugging on legacy and others' code, sometimes when no other engineers are available.
  • You are happy with our boring and legacy technologies (Laravel, PHP, plain JS, HTML, CSS, Salesforce, Wordpress, SQL, wrangling csv files etc). You don’t have to be experienced in all of them, but you do have to be genuinely happy to use them (many engineers are not…).

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment  — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Flexible Working

À propos de nous

Chez Wavo, nous construisons le futur du financement de stocks. Pour les PME, le stock est à la fois une opportunité et une contrainte. Il immobilise de la trésorerie, freine la croissance et crée du risque. Les solutions de financement traditionnelles sont lentes, rigides et basées sur l’historique financier plutôt que sur le potentiel business en temps réel.


Nous adoptons une approche différente. Wavo achète et finance les stocks en amont, sans dette ni garantie personnelle. Les entreprises peuvent ainsi accélérer leur croissance, améliorer leur trésorerie et se concentrer sur leur développement, sans friction financière.


Nous avons levé 10M€ pour accélérer notre expansion et déployer notre modèle auprès de plus d’entreprises. Nous sommes soutenus par des investisseurs et des leaders du secteur qui nous donnent les moyens d’aller vite. Notre objectif est clair : devenir la référence du financement de stocks intégré en Europe.


L’équipe tech est aujourd’hui composée de trois full stack et trois ingénieurs data, qui ont posé des fondations solides. Nous recrutons maintenant un quatrième développeur pour accompagner la montée en charge du produit et de l’équipe.


Le poste

En tant que Full Stack Engineer chez Wavo, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la construction et l’évolution de notre plateforme. Tu interviendras sur l’ensemble du produit, du backend au frontend, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur la qualité, la robustesse et la scalabilité.

La stack est en place, les bases sont solides, et beaucoup reste à construire. Le poste s’adresse à un profil senior qui aime comprendre des problématiques métier complexes, prendre des décisions techniques structurantes et contribuer activement à faire évoluer un produit critique.

Tu travailleras au quotidien avec Maxence et PA, ainsi qu’en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Product, Data et Ops. L’environnement est exigeant, mais sain, avec une vraie culture d’ingénierie et un fort respect du travail bien fait.

Nous aimons raisonner en termes de coût d’innovation : chaque choix technologique est assumé et arbitré collectivement, en réservant l’innovation aux sujets où elle crée un réel avantage.

  • Base de données & infra : PostgreSQL, hébergement managé, déploiements et scaling sans interruption

UX/UI Designer (Design Engineer)

Location: Amsterdam, NL (beautiful office right near Leidseplein)

Work Structure: Hybrid (4 days on-site, 1 day flexible remote)

Experience Level: 2–4 years

Type: Freelancer

About Creative Clicks

At Creative Clicks, we move fast, think big, and drive results. As a global leader in data-driven performance marketing, we combine high-impact user experiences with sharp creative to scale brands across continents.

Our culture is built on our Triple E philosophy: Energy, Entrepreneurship, and Expertise. We operate with a vibrant, agile startup mentality and no corporate red tape. If you have an idea, you test it. If you see a friction point in a user journey, you fix it. We are expanding our Amsterdam headquarters and looking for a designer who ships: a UX/UI Designer who takes their own work from Figma all the way to a live Next.js production site.

The Role

This is not a classic handoff role. You design the experience and you publish it. Your Figma file becomes a live page because you built it, in Next.js, often the same week.

Day to day you will design and ship high-converting landing pages, onboarding quiz funnels, and lifecycle emails; manage the websites they live on; and keep improving them with CRO experiments. AI-assisted building ("vibe coding" with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or v0) is core to how this role works, not a side experiment. You will touch several verticals and own things end to end: design, build, CMS, tracking, iteration.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and publish, yourself: Map user journeys, wireframe, design high-fidelity screens in Figma, then build and deploy them in Next.js. No waiting on a dev sprint.

  • Own the website stack: Manage our sites end to end. Set up and maintain a headless CMS so the team can edit content without touching code, and keep deployments, domains, and tracking healthy.

  • Run optimisations and CRO: Analyze user behavior and funnel data, form hypotheses, ship A/B tests, and iterate based on real performance metrics.

  • Work across verticals: Landing pages are the core, but you will also design and build onboarding quiz flows and email campaigns, so the same brain covers the whole funnel.

  • Frontrun with AI: Actively use AI design and coding tools to collapse the distance between idea and live page. Prototype in hours, ship in days.

Who You Are

  • The sweet-spot experienced: 2–4 years as a UX/UI, product, or web designer, with shipped web work to show for it (conversion-driven e-commerce or startup experience is a major plus).

  • Master of Figma: Clean component-based design systems, auto-layout, interactive prototypes.

  • You publish, not just hand off: Comfortable enough with Next.js, React, and Tailwind (with AI tools doing the heavy lifting) to take your own design live in production. You don’t need to be a senior engineer. You need to ship.

  • Infrastructure doesn’t scare you: Hosting and deployments (e.g. Vercel), domains and DNS, analytics and tracking scripts, and headless CMS setup (Sanity, Contentful, Payload, or similar) are things you can figure out and own.

  • Data-informed and AI-native: You design what works, not just what looks good. You read funnel data, session recordings, and test results, and you turn them into the next iteration.

  • Thrives in a dynamic culture: Rapid A/B testing, quick iterations, shifting priorities based on performace data. You enjoy that.

  • Portfolio driven: Live URLs beat static mocks. We want to see things you designed AND built.

HSE Specialist | DSL-01

Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten.

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project.

Over de functie

Als HSE Specialist speel je een belangrijke rol in het veilig voorbereiden van een nieuwe chemische procesinstallatie op ingebruikname. Je werkt nauw samen met engineers, projectteams, contractors en toekomstige operations collega's om de processen, systemen en veiligheidsmaatregelen te ontwikkelen die nodig zijn voor een veilige opstart en bedrijfsvoering van DSL-01.

DSL-01 bevindt zich in de overgang van projectuitvoering naar operationele gereedheid. Om een veilige opstart en succesvolle lange termijn exploitatie mogelijk te maken, moeten alle benodigde QHSES-processen, procedures, systemen en tools worden ontwikkeld, geïmplementeerd en geborgd binnen de organisatie. In deze functie ondersteun je de QHSES Manager bij het realiseren van deze ambitie en draag je bij aan naleving van wet- en regelgeving, vergunningseisen, ISO-normen en interne bedrijfsstandaarden. Neemt bij afwezigheid van de QHSES Manager aangewezen QHSES-taken over en ziet toe op de naleving van veiligheidsvoorschriften, procedures en wettelijke verplichtingen om een veilige werkomgeving te waarborgen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • QHSES-managementsysteem & compliance: Ondersteunen bij de ontwikkeling, implementatie en continue verbetering van het DSL-01 Integrated Management System en bijdragen aan naleving van bedrijfsstandaarden, wet- en regelgeving en best practices binnen de industrie.

  • Vergunningen & wettelijke naleving: Ondersteunen bij milieuvergunningen, vergunningswijzigingen, compliance-monitoring en het beheer van wettelijke registers, waaronder REACH-gerelateerde verplichtingen.

  • Risicomanagement & assurance: Ondersteunen bij proces- en veiligheidsrisicoanalyses, zoals HAZID-, HAZOP- en RI&E-trajecten, het beheren van risicoregisters en het ondersteunen van audits, inspecties en incidentonderzoeken om risico's binnen een industriële procesomgeving te beheersen.

  • Documentatie, training & operationele gereedheid: Opstellen, beheren en onderhouden van procedures, werkinstructies, trainingsvereisten en overige QHSES-documentatie om de organisatie voor te bereiden op veilige en conforme bedrijfsvoering.

  • Stakeholder- & projectondersteuning: Fungeren als verbindende schakel tussen de corporate QHSES-organisatie en het DSL-01-projectteam en bijdragen aan certificeringstrajecten, occupational health-programma's en de succesvolle implementatie van QHSES-initiatieven.

Jouw profiel

We zijn een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je beschikt over een MBO+/HBO-opleiding in Veiligheidskunde, Milieukunde, Techniek, Integrale Veiligheidskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Health, Safety, Environment of QHSES-gerelateerde functies.

  • Je hebt ervaring in een industriële, chemische, productie-, energie- of andere hoog-risico omgeving.

  • Je hebt een goed begrip van arbeidsveiligheidswetgeving, risicomanagement en compliance vereisten.

  • Je hebt ervaring met ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 en/of Seveso/BRZO-gerelateerde kaders.

  • Je bent bekend met risicogestuurd werken en continu verbeteren.

  • Je hebt ervaring met RI&E-processen en risicoregisters.

  • Je beschikt over sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en werkt nauwkeurig met documentatie en systemen.

Bonus

  • Certificeringen zoals NEBOSH, HVK, MVK of vergelijkbaar.

  • Ervaring met chemische veiligheidsvraagstukken en REACH-verplichtingen.

  • Ervaring met ISO-certificeringstrajecten en externe audits.

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten.

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen we aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Wat wij bieden

DSL-01 is volop in ontwikkeling. Dat geldt niet alleen voor de fabriek, maar ook voor de organisatie en de arbeidsvoorwaarden. Ons HR-team werkt aan een passend en marktconform pakket voor de locatie in Delfzijl.

Je kunt rekenen op een goed salaris, een bonusregeling en arbeidsvoorwaarden die ruimte bieden voor jouw professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Solliciteer

Wil jij meebouwen aan een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com.

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

The company

Imagine a world where every small business has the power to thrive. That's the world we're building at iwoca. Small businesses aren't just statistics – they're the heartbeat of our communities, the character of our high streets, and the engine of our economy. Since 2012, we've revolutionised how these businesses access finance, turning what was once a lengthy, frustrating process into something remarkable: funding that's fast, flexible, and actually works for modern businesses.

Our impact speaks for itself: we've provided billions in funding to over 150,000 businesses across Europe, making us one of the continent's leading fintech innovators. But we're just getting started. Our mission? To empower one million businesses with the financial tools they deserve.

We combine cutting-edge technology and data science with genuine human understanding to make finance feel less like a barrier and more like a superpower. Whether it's managing cash flow or seizing unexpected opportunities, we ensure businesses get the funds they need – often within minutes.

The team

The Repeats team is one of iwoca's funnel teams. We grow customer lifetime value after a business's first loan. That means we own the underwriting, pricing, and product experience for two segments that make up most of iwoca's back-book value: top-up customers who borrow again while still repaying, and loan-ended customers who return for a new loan. Almost every repeat borrower goes through code we own. The team is cross-functional – backend, frontend, product, design, data science and analytics – shipping behind split tests and measuring impact in Looker rather than on gut feel.

Your first project will be the re-architecture of our flex-loan repeat offer pipeline: the flow that decides who is eligible for a new loan, what they pay, and how much they can borrow. This area has been under-invested for years. Once the new pipeline is in place, product has a clear runway of features ready to ship on top of it.

100+

industrial clients

40k+

connected suppliers

Each Tracklab deployment starts as a SaaS platform implemented within a single industrial company, structuring its compliance and operational data. But the real power comes from what happens next. As companies invite their suppliers and partners onto the platform, these individual deployments connect together, forming a trusted data network across supply chains.

Tracklab Was Founded In The End Of 2022 By

  • Nicolas Henry (Ponts & Chaussées, Columbia University, ex-Uber San Francisco)
  • Fadel Bennani (HEC Paris, ex-Bain & Company)

You will report directly to Quentin, our Tech Lead, and work daily with our Product team and our AI Engineer.

Descriptif du poste

We are a small engineering team building a platform that 800+ industrial users rely on every single day. The team is deliberately dense: 4 engineers and 2 product people, plus an AI Engineer. Everyone owns features end to end, from the data model to the screen the client actually uses.

⚖️ This is a full-stack, high-autonomy role. You will not be handed tickets. You will be handed problems, and you will be expected to come back with a plan.

🇫🇷🇺🇸 The main language is French, but English proficiency is a must-have.

What you'll own

🚀 Features, end to end

From the spec review to production monitoring. You own the whole path, not a layer of it.

⚙️ Backend that holds under real load

NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis. Clean APIs, honest error handling, no magic.

🤖 An AI-assisted workflow

You code with AI every day and you know exactly where it is wrong. You help the team get better at it.

🧱 The core data model

Products, suppliers, documents, versions, audit trails. The hardest part of our platform is not the UI, it is the model underneath.

🖥️ Interfaces people use all day

React and Next.js. Our users spend six hours a day in Tracklab. It has to be fast and it has to be obvious.

⚡ A quality bar we automate

Tests, review, checks in CI. We would rather teach an agent to catch a class of bug than catch it by hand twice. You will build that tooling, not just use it.

Profil recherché

Most important qualities for this role at Tracklab

  • You ship. You have a track record of features that went to production and stayed there
  • You are pragmatic about quality: you know the difference between the corner that can be cut and the one that will cost six months
  • You challenge the spec. When something does not make sense, you say so before you build it, not after
  • You are comfortable in a codebase you did not write, in a domain you do not know yet
  • You use AI as a real multiplier and you read every line it produces
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive in a fast-moving environment where the answer is rarely written down anywhere

Skills & Experience

Must haves

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering, including at least one company with a serious engineering culture
  • Strong TypeScript, on both sides of the stack
  • Solid relational data modeling and SQL. You can design a schema, not just query one
  • You already code with AI daily (Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent) and you can explain where it fails
  • Clear written communication in French and English
  • You have owned features end to end, including what happened after the release

Nice to haves

  • NestJS and Next.js in production
  • GCP, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines
  • Python
  • B2B SaaS with deep data models: PLM, PIM, ERP, MES, QMS or similar
  • Experience in agri-food, cosmetics, chemicals or another regulated industry

Our stack

TypeScript everywhere. NestJS on the backend, React / Next.js on the frontend, PostgreSQL (Cloud SQL) and Redis. Infrastructure on GCP, managed with Terraform. Python for our AI and data work. GitHub for everything.

  • Apply

Send your resume, LinkedIn or GitHub profile to jobs@tracklab.co.

🤙 2. Screening call (15 min)

A short call to cover the essentials: availability, notice period, location, languages, compensation, and what brings you to Tracklab.

A 35-minute video call with Quentin, our Tech Lead. No live coding: instead, you walk us through two technical cases from your past experience.

  • 1-hour system design and data modeling session
  • 45-minute product session with one of our PMs

Two or three calls with people you have worked with.

🚀 6. Offer

Formal offer to join the Tracklab team.

  • Date de début : 31 octobre 2026

The Context

Banks still run their most critical, regulated work by hand; reading letters and emails, re-keying data between systems, chasing down missing info. It's the kind of work that's too important to get wrong and too tedious for anyone to want to do.

Porters fixes this. Our AI agents run these regulated processes end to end, with the audit trails and security banks actually require, so the work moves at the speed customers expect instead of the speed a backlog allows.

We're just over a year old and already live with real customers, growing the product quickly, and were named Fintech of the Year 2026. The goal is to build the operating system for autonomous banking. We're backed by Earlybird, one of Europe's oldest venture firms, and Seedcamp, who wrote first checks into Revolut, Wise, and UiPath.

The Mission

You'll own the outcomes. You take an ambiguous business problem and turn it into clear requirements, a design with clear business rationale, sequenced work, and a realistic estimate, build the hardest parts yourself, and multiply a team of mid-level engineers with well-defined, extensible work and the reviews that keep quality high. You stay an IC at heart while making the work legible, sized, and worth doing.

This job is in person in Zurich, or remote in Barcelona or Berlin.

Your responsibilities

  • Deliver the highest-risk work yourself: Be the IC where it matters. Personally engineer the most complex, business-critical components, from cross-service logic to the boundary where AI outputs become deterministic, auditable actions, and set the technical bar for the team as you go.

  • Turn business goals into shipped projects: Take an ambiguous problem and own it through to delivery, defining requirements, a design that starts from customer impact and takes the highest-ROI path whether it's make or buy, sequenced work, estimates, and clear engineering acceptance criteria a team can execute with minimal churn.

  • Design complex systems that don’t break down in 12 months: Architect entire systems so the likely next requirement plugs in cleanly through configuration or a new adapter, keeping components reusable and loosely coupled, separating business logic from shared services, and maintaining a single authoritative, append-only source of truth for critical data - including consideration of make-or-buy options.

  • Scale the team's autonomy and quality: Set decision thresholds so engineers self-serve low-stakes calls, define sanctioned paths for experimenting with regulated data, and spread understanding of our systems to cut key-person risk. Settle design in review, then build the road to production: CI/CD with quality gates, automated migrations, and systems that report their own health.

  • Wow our customers: You solve for the customer's actual problem, not just the request, and measure success by customer outcomes. What would it take for the customer to say “Porters made my day!”?

Your profile

  • Experience: Typically 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a track record of shipping in fast-paced, ambiguous environments. Regulated industry and/or VC-backed startup experiences are a plus.

  • IC strength: A hands-on builder who ships the hard things, and who naturally thinks in business outcomes, work packages, ROI, and extensibility.

  • Project definition: Proven ability to write requirements and designs from business context, break them into estimated, sequenced work, and drive a project to completion in a tool like Linear.

  • Technical proficiency: Deep proficiency in Python is mandatory, with strong command of REST API design, relational data modeling, and layered, service-oriented architecture.

  • AI-native: Real experience building LLM/agentic tooling, and understanding how to bound probabilistic output with deterministic code.

  • Natural leader: You lift the people around you through design review, coaching, and clear direction, and you enjoy doing it.

  • Going the extra mile: Be part of a high-growth phase, where we move fast and expect focused intensity. 9-to-5 is not the mode we work in, if you want to build something that matters with a team that ships, we are your people.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of whole product areas: Latitude to shape what we build and how we scope, sequence, and ship it, with a team to build it with.

  • Founder collaboration: Work directly with founders who have built and scaled fintech and analytics products before.

  • We win and lose together as a team: We expect people to leave their comfort zone on a daily basis, however, we work together as a team and support each other at any time.

  • Growth: A dedicated development budget, free to use for whatever gives you a level-up.

  • Culture: Strong focus on a healthy, high-performance team culture, ranging from regular team events and dinners to an inclusive, fast-paced team that grows together.

Our stack

  • Core Backend: Python 3.14, FastAPI, Pydantic, and SQLAlchemy 2.0 in a strict four-layer architecture, exposed as separate internal and external APIs.

  • Background processing: Containerized worker services and event-driven AWS Lambda orchestrators for email ingestion, document triaging, and action running.

  • AI Integration: AI orchestration deeply integrated into application landscape via AWS Bedrock, e.g., to extract information and drive agentic activity.

  • Data & Storage: Per-tenant Aurora MySQL in isolated subnets, S3 for document persistence, and an append-only ledger for auditability.

  • Platform: A multi-tenant AWS environment on ECS Fargate with strict per-tenant network and data isolation (VPC, NACLs, WAF), CloudFront + Cognito (Google SSO/JWT) and API Gateway (IAM) at the edge, defined as code in CloudFormation across dev/staging/prod accounts.

  • Frontend: React single-page app for the internal workbench.

We're a small, high-impact engineering team embedded inside the Go-To-Market organization. Our job is to make Bloomreach impossible to ignore in a sales cycle by using AI to build demo environments, automate work, and create self-serve tools for presales teams around the world.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The AI Foundations Team at Mural is pioneering how generative AI transforms visual collaboration and decision-making. We’re a remote-first group of engineers, designers, and product thinkers focused on helping teams work together more effectively. Our goal isn’t to replace human creativity. It’s to amplify it, building AI that enhances how people align, communicate, and make decisions visually.

YOUR MISSION

You will design and build the core AI systems and platforms that enable Mural’s next wave of agentic, AI-driven collaboration experiences.

Rather than building isolated AI features, you’ll work on the core backend systems that power Mural’s agent platform, including agent orchestration, durable execution, contextual memory, tool integration, observability, and evaluation. Your work will enable intelligent agents to reason over product context, act on behalf of users, and operate reliably and safely at scale. Our stack at Mural includes Azure OpenAI, React, Node, MongoDB.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build the core backend systems that power Mural’s agent platform, including orchestration, durable execution, tool execution, memory, observability, and evaluation infrastructure

  • Design scalable services and APIs that allow AI agents to retrieve context, coordinate multi-step workflows, interact with Mural data, and act reliably on behalf of users

  • Develop the agent memory layer, including systems for conversation context, product context, retrieval, summarization, compaction, and long-term context management

  • Create infrastructure to monitor, debug, and improve agent behavior through traces, metrics, feedback loops, and offline evaluation

  • Translate complex, open-ended product needs into clear backend architectures, service boundaries, data models, and implementation plans that align technical capabilities with user value

  • Help define the technical direction for agentic AI at Mural, contributing to long-term architecture and strategy

  • Champion engineering excellence, mentoring others and establishing best practices for building reliable AI systems

  • Contribute to team growth through hiring, process improvements, and fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and inclusivity

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with strong expertise designing, building, and operating reliable production systems, scalable services and APIs, and well-defined system architectures

  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems for complex workflows, including orchestration, asynchronous processing, job execution, retries, event-driven architectures, long-running processes, and failure recovery

  • Familiarity with AI, LLM, or agentic systems, including concepts such as tool use, context retrieval, evaluation, or model orchestration

  • Strong focus on production quality, including observability, reliability, testing, security, maintainability, and incident response

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and collaborate cross-functionally

  • Experience working full stack or collaborating closely on product-facing frontend experiences

  • Deeper AI/ML experience, especially with LLM evaluation, experimentation, embeddings, retrieval systems

  • Experience with knowledge graphs, graph-based data modeling, entity resolution, or relationship-aware retrieval systems

OUR STACK

Azure OpenAI, React, Node, MongoDB

What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
  • Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
  • Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
  • Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
  • Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
  • You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
  • Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
  • Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have:
  • Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
  • Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
  • Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
  • You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline


What You Get

  • Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
  • Competitive salary
  • Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company
  • Central office, easy commute — free lunch every Tuesday and Thursday
  • Wellpass membership
  • Regular 1:1s and retros focused on your growth
  • Real impact — your work supports Europe's transition to a smarter energy system
